name: io.github.emilkrebs/med-research-mcp
title: Med Research
description: Evidence-graded literature search: PubMed, Europe PMC, ChinaXiv, RussiaRxiv with study-design tiers.

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Your contact email, sent with every NCBI (PubMed) request as its usage policy asks, so NCBI can reach you before blocking an IP that exceeds its limits. Also used for Unpaywall and ChinaRxiv when their own emails aren't set. Without one, NCBI and Unpaywall requests carry the project's contact address instead.

environmentVariables.name: NCBI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Raises the PubMed rate limit from 3 to 10 requests per second. Create one in your NCBI account settings.

environmentVariables.name: MED_RESEARCH_UNPAYWALL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Contact email for Unpaywall, which literature_fulltext asks for open-access copies. Falls back to NCBI_EMAIL, then to the project's contact address.

environmentVariables.name: MED_RESEARCH_PROXY_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Your institution's EZproxy host for doi.org, e.g. https://doi-org.ezproxy.your-university.edu, to read paywalled papers you have access to. It works only if the proxy lets this machine in without a login, e.g. on the campus network or VPN. Use it only if your institution's licences allow it: many publishers forbid using subscription content with AI tools.
